name: v27-d-10-edit-catch-up
objective: v2.7 10 option C live (D) row, no model. A mocked read carries the story start -> door at the boundary of Arin's reply. The main read lane is then held by a scheduler job that waits for the scenario (so the edit's re-read stays queued until released; the hold is a scheduler job, not a model call). Editing the newest reply rolls the story back and queues the 'rollback:<id>:edit' re-read: the pipeline reads catching-up ('Catching up after your edit…', HUD chip 'catching up after your edit') while it waits, and assert-player-clean is green in that state. Control: before the edit the same held lane does not read catching-up. Released, the re-read runs on the pinned mock (SCENE_NONE), its audit lands, rereadReason clears and the pipeline settles to idle. The existing plan03a-edit-rollback never asserts catching-up. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-d-10-edit-catch-up.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" (a no-model lane: st-lanes.mts no-model <n>).

requires.why: every read is mocked (SCENE_NONE pin, extract debugResponse); the hold is a scheduler job the scenario releases; the real re-read leg is v2.8 01 O10

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so the message ids below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

steps.eval: const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const pipe = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().pipeline; const sched = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.scheduler; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!rt.scheduler || typeof rt.scheduler.schedule !== 'function') throw new Error('the runtime has no attached scheduler'); globalThis.__v27d10 = { audits: rt.getExtractionAudits().length }; rt.scheduler.schedule({ priority: 1, reason: 'v27d10-hold', run: () => new Promise((resolve) => { globalThis.__v27d10.release = resolve; }) }); await until(() => typeof globalThis.__v27d10.release === 'function', 5000, 'the hold job to start on the read lane'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); if (pipe().state === 'catching-up') throw new Error('control: the pipeline reads catching-up with no edit'); return { heldLane: true, pipeline: pipe().state, scheduler: sched() };

edit.text: You leave the key on its hook.

steps.eval: const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const pipe = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().pipeline; const sched = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.scheduler; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await until(() => pipe().state === 'catching-up', 8000, 'the pipeline to read catching-up after the edit'); const reason = sched().rereadReason; if (!/^rollback:\d+:edit$/.test(String(reason))) throw new Error(`the queued re-read is not the edit's: ${reason}`); if (rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`the edit did not roll the story back: ${rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId}`); const hud = document.getElementById('so-hud-pipeline')?.textContent?.trim() ?? null; if (hud !== 'catching up after your edit') throw new Error(`the HUD chip reads ${JSON.stringify(hud)}`); return { pipeline: pipe().text, reason, hud };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const pipe = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().pipeline; const sched = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.scheduler; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (pipe().state !== 'catching-up') throw new Error(`the re-read ran before it was released: ${pipe().state}`); globalThis.__v27d10.release(); await until(() => !sched().rereadReason && !sched().inFlight && sched().queueDepth === 0, 15000, 'the edit re-read to run and leave the queue'); const audits = rt.getExtractionAudits(); const reread = audits.slice(globalThis.__v27d10.audits).find((audit) => String(audit.reason).startsWith('rollback:')); if (!reread) throw new Error(`no re-read audit landed: ${JSON.stringify(audits.slice(globalThis.__v27d10.audits).map((audit) => audit.reason))}`); await until(() => pipe().state === 'idle', 10000, `the pipeline to settle to idle (it reads ${pipe().state})`); return { reread: reread.reason, pipeline: pipe().state };
if (typeof globalThis.__v27d10?.release === 'function') globalThis.__v27d10.release(); return { released: true };
